citation.description: _assert_filter_protocol checks GIT_TRACE_PACKET for actual filter negotiation (not config-presence); _assert_historical_blob_missing confirms blobs are absent; _size_pack_kib measures actual pack sizes; test_named_origin_filter_is_negotiated_and_omits_blob and test_standalone_guard_accepts_blobless/rejects_full do before/after pack size comparisons; named_origin path sets remote.origin.partialclonefilter and verifies it is negotiated.

criteria.criterion: A controlled before/after byte measurement (pack size, or GIT_TRACE_PACKET received bytes) of a fresh CI checkout with and without the filter shows the expected reduction, AND the subsequent manual tickets fetch is confirmed to inherit remote.origin.partialclonefilter. Must NOT be a config-presence assertion.

citation.description: test_blobless_tickets_reconverges_and_pushes: fetches bloblessly, creates diverged local state, sets merge.ours.driver=true, merges and pushes successfully.

criteria.criterion: A reconverge against a diverged remote succeeds on a blobless runner (proves B3 landed before B1 and the merge driver is defined).

citation.description: test_force_cannot_override_an_advertised_branch_fetch_failure: real bare remote with advertised tickets branch, git shim injects fetch failure, asserts returncode != 0 and no tickets branch/worktree created.

criteria.criterion: With a reachable remote advertising tickets, a simulated fetch failure causes a non-zero exit and no orphan branch is created. Tier: CLI subprocess against a real temporary remote. This is the RED case for P1 01e8-302b.

citation.description: test_partial_failure_aborts_but_successful_empty_does_not: injects None for one path's blame, asserts derive_caused_by returns None. Implementation at blame.py:114-115 returns None when shas is None.

criteria.criterion: derive_caused_by returns None when blame fails on any path, rather than tallying a partial path set and electing a culprit that would not have won over the full set. Tier: unit test injecting a per-path failure, asserting no link event is written.

citation.description: test_signed_resolvers_return_only_the_introducing_sha: creates a real git repo with SSH-signed commits and log.showSignature=true, verifies both resolvers return a valid 40-hex SHA and use -c log.showSignature=false --no-renames flags.

criteria.criterion: With log.showSignature=true and signed commits in the fixture repo, resolve_event_commit and resolve_position_commit return a valid 40-hex SHA. The signing is load-bearing: with --format=%H over unsigned commits the setting emits no extra lines, so an unsigned fixture makes this vacuously green. Tier: unit against a real temporary git repo.

citation.description: search_files for 'bak-retarget' returns no matches in actual source/working-tree files (only in a plan-review cache JSON). list_directory of repo root confirms the file is absent. The 33 MB size drop is a git-history fact consistent with the file's absence.

criteria.criterion: .bridge_state.bak-retarget is absent from the tree at HEAD and working-tree size drops by >=33 MB.

citation.description: Doc exists; states 'a full clone took 1.04 GiB / 59 s' and 'A blobless clone took 68.7 MiB / 14.3 s'; describes git blame degradation and the fail-closed behavior.

criteria.criterion: The clone-guidance doc exists and states the measured numbers (full 1.04 GiB / 59s vs blob:none 68.7 MiB / 14.3s) and the accepted git blame degradation.
